patch-mcp.note: Hosted Patch MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE). The user verifies an eligible phone number by SMS code or automated call and approves the connection. No API key to configure. Tools: get_phone_number, estimate_call, place_call, get_call, list_calls, end_call, set_call_visibility. Calls use the authenticated user's verified caller ID. Texting, picture messages and text event subscriptions are coming soon and unavailable; do not start a text listener. Only endpoint contacted by the plugin: https://www.patchmcp.com. Terms: https://www.patchmcp.com/terms
